notes.title: Changelog Demo v0.5.1 5/11/23
notes.notes:
Minor update with some fixes and changes:

- Made most UI objects change size with screen, before they had a fixed size.
- Fixed Compass for level 1 and 2.
- Fixed L-Bar Furniture collider issue.
- Added a light before the lvl2 boss arena.
- Made boss names in the enemy zoo bigger.
- Changed text from "Store" to "Shop" for the shop teleporter.
